## What's new

- crt-lottes-fast (flat, as recommended) now works four screen pixels at a
  time on the Brick's processor. Same picture, pixel for pixel; check the
  Shader menu's Speed rows in an NES or SNES game to see the difference.

---

ChaOS 0.11.3 for the TrimUI Brick and Brick Hammer.

**Install or update** with [ChaOS Installer](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS-Installer/releases/latest), or write `ChaOS-v0.11.3-brick.img.xz` to a card yourself (that erases it).

ChaOS is built on [TortOS 2.1.1](https://github.com/ericreinsmidt/TortOS/releases/tag/v2.1.1) by Eric Reinsmidt. `ChaOS-v0.11.3-brick-sources.tar` is the source of everything in the image; what came from where is in [CREDITS.md](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS/blob/main/CREDITS.md).
